scope: Mac native app common online TTS sentence pipeline; international service; no OReilly acceptance or mobile/extension release

references.finding: Shared KindleSentenceBuffer merged complete sentences up to 480 characters. TTS startup special-cased cloned voices and live readers could override it. Existing SpeechStreamBuffer owns a bounded producer across prefetch promotion.
tts-service uses partly endpoint and unprocessed suffix; orchestrator queues segments as they arrive. Word-capable languages do not invariably use one sentence per request.
First audio response enters playback before remaining paragraph parts; cloned requests use authenticated transport; KindleContinuousReading retains source page/word anchors independently of playback.

design: Keep document paragraphs and provider source/page anchors as the display/navigation identity.
Plan bounded sentence requests centrally in TTSService for both buffered and legacy cloud generation, including raw live-source continuations.

Never merge adjacent complete sentences to fill a batch. First request bounded to 120 UTF-16 units (48 CJK), subsequent units to 240 (96 CJK). Split long sentences at clause/word boundaries; preserve extended graphemes and all normalized text.
Mark saved request continuations as already planned; retries preserve exact unfinished tail, segment index and idempotency identity.
Immediately deliver each completed audio segment to the existing player; subsequent work obeys duration/byte limits and pause/cancellation ownership.
Kindle retains only the unfinished sentence across a confirmed page edge and its source spans; no adjacent complete-sentence batching.
Create Kindle startup playback models after the final sentence document is ready, skipping temporary OCR-document playback models.
Do not withhold a new Google Books/Kobo opening segment while building an eight-second reserve; retain the existing exact short-resume protection.
Record transport elapsed time and forwarded worker queue/run headers without source text or credentials.
remainingBoundary: No promise of a fixed production startup latency or uninterrupted 3x under insufficient synthesis throughput; verify the actual candidate after unit tests.
